title: High fever with shaking chills after a trip abroad; anxious patient, husband speaks first, urgent tests
description: Fictional synthetic consultation for Module 3 testing; not a real patient record or medical advice.

design.opening: the husband speaks first and gives the headline; the patient cuts in to correct him
design.patient_style: anxious, asks worried questions, speaks fast
partial_or_uncertain: paracetamol: she cannot say how many Dolo she has taken in 24 hours ('four, maybe five, maybe six')
she does not remember the name of the malaria tablets the clinic offered before the trip, only that they were not collected
diagnosis is uncertain (malaria first, dengue possible)
facts: fever with shaking chills for three days, headache for a week, sweating a lot
no diarrhoea, rash, neck stiffness, cough
Foracort inhaler twice a day, Dolo 650
smokes about half a pack a day, stopped heavy drinking four years ago, grandmother had dementia
spleen tip just palpable, chest clear
plan: malaria test and blood film, blood cultures, fluids, return at once if confused or cannot keep fluids down
